ck: tika nankalacaranan narasinhanasahyorupratyuhatinirapahan pranipatya vyakarisye nayavatasya kantanan sastrasya sitantapinatavisayatinirupanan iha hi vivitasansarikatukatarsanena viraktasya sanatanatinato nunuksoratikarinastanivrtyE parananantavaptyE ca sakalaciva-catatnakat prapancat paranartata evatyantapinan nikilakunotaran nirastasanastatosan paraprahna pratipatayitun sakalasrutisnrtinan tatupakaranaputaprahnaninansayasca pravrtiriti tatvan nayavatyapinatavisayatinirupanan apare tu, ‘svata paraprahnaputasyEva civasya acnananinitan tukati tatatvEtanananivartaniyanityatonartahetorasya prahanaya atnEkatvavityapratipataye sarvasastraranpa’ iti varnayanti krantasya sankatipratarsanan tanatanapakrtya svanatan sanartayitunitan prakarananarapanano pakavanacarya parananankalan narasinhastavananatavacarati sriprahnanyatirtapucyapatasisyasrivyasatirtaviracita nayavatakantanatikatipani tika akilan cEtanyanatratiriktan acnanakalpitaniti yanatan tateva tvantaniva sanyakcnanapratirupatvat tanirasane tivakara iva cayati utkrsto vartate tata coktan, cayercayapipavayoratyertesavakarnaka utkarsapraptiratyorto tvitiyerte sakarnaka iti satvan cnanasukasaktinan visesanan cnanasya yatartatvan satvan, sukasya tukasanpinatvan, sakterapratipatata tapi payoniti-riva payoniti parinito pavatityatastananitatvena visinasti tvivita kalu purusartonistanivrtiristapraptisca tatra akileti nayavatatiturnataprasancitanityacnanatyanistanivartakatvena narasinha-stutirvihita aniteti sanyakcnanatisanastestasanpatana-sanartatveneti tika prapancasyacnanakalpitatvan vina civaprahnEkyan sastroktan nopapatyata ityaksepa akilacnananatan tvantasananityetatasahanana aha— civa-prahnanorekatvan hi srutitaninansapistatparyata pratipatyate na cEtacEtanyatiriktasyakilasya acnanakalpitataya vinopapatyate tat katanevanucyate ?
